_comment: Assertions are at error unless listed here. Off: unused-javascript/unused-css-rules report false positives on Astro/Tailwind output that's already purged; lcp-lazy-loaded/prioritize-lcp-image are noisy because the LCP element varies per page; non-composited-animations flags utility CSS transitions on hover; uses-long-cache-ttl can't be evaluated against a static dist (Cloudflare _headers sets immutable 1y on /assets/* in production); robots-txt flags the intentional Content-Signal directive (contentsignals.org) as an 'Unknown directive' because Lighthouse's validator only safelists the classic directives, a false positive. Warn: network-dependency-tree-insight, because the trace engine marks any critical chain of 2+ requests (document then any subresource) as failed, so every page scores 0. On 2026-11-15 the other warn-level waivers (csp-xss, canonical, offscreen-images, dom-size, modern-image-formats, cumulative-layout-shift, identical-links-same-purpose, total-byte-weight, image-delivery-insight, cls-culprits-insight, forced-reflow-insight) had not fired in the last 10 green runs on main, so they went back to error. If one starts failing, fix the page or move it back to warn here with the reason.
